reason: The README clearly shows this plugin is a communication bridge between side-chat and the main agent: it adds UI and slash-command mechanisms to send side-chat messages as user follow-ups in the main session and trigger the main agent turn, so the user-facing purpose is collaboration/hand-off support across chat contexts.

summaries.zh: 该插件在侧边聊天中提供“Notify main agent”入口与指令，可将信息一键推送到主会话并让主代理继续处理下一轮。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a side-chat entry and commands to send messages directly into the main conversation so the main agent can take over on its next turn.

capabilities: adds a floating side-chat UI control to notify the main agent
registers global slash commands to forward side-chat text to the main session
routes side-chat messages into the main conversation as user follow-up messages
uses agent session context to deliver messages via host-side APIs
